mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park. The moon is in its Waning Gibbous phase, and you can expect an overnight low of 49 degrees with rain likely before morning.

In city news, the Public Works Department reminds residents that refuse and recycling are managed by Pellitteri Waste Systems, and you can find your specific collection schedule on their website. Also, remember that alternate-side winter parking regulations take effect from November 20 through April 1 to help with snow removal.

We have plenty going on in the community. Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat at Hometown Junction Park. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmer's Market takes over the Capitol Square.
Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I offence.

Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The Culver's of Verona is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
